title: Lengthening the Guanidine-Aryl Linker of Phenylpyrimidinylguanidines Increases Their Potency as Inhibitors of FOXO3-Induced Gene Transcription.
authors: Kohoutova, Klara; Docekal, Vojtech; Ausserlechner, Michael J; Kaiser, Nora; Tekel, Andrej; Mandal, Raju; Horvath, Matej; Obsilova, Veronika; Vesely, Jan; Hagenbuchner, Judith; Obsil, Tomas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯基嘧啶胍类化合物抑制FOXO3转录活性的构效关系，虽涉及FOXO3-DNA结合域和分子对接，但核心是药物化学抑制剂开发，而非TF-DNA互作机制或AI/物理模拟方法研究。
abstract: Increased FOXO3 nuclear localization is involved in neuroblastoma chemoresistance and tumor angiogenesis. Accordingly, FOXO3 inhibition is a promising strategy for boosting antitumor immune responses and suppressing FOXO3-mediated therapy resistance in cancer cells. However, no FOXO3 inhibitors are currently available for clinical use. Nevertheless, we have recently identified (4-propoxy)phenylpyrimidinylguanidine as a FOXO3 inhibitor in cancer cells in the low micromolar range. Here, we report the synthesis and structure-activity relationship study of a small library of its derivatives, some of which inhibit FOXO3-induced gene transcription in cancer cells in a submicromolar range and are thus 1 order of magnitude more potent than their parent compound. By NMR and molecular docking, we showed that these compounds differ in their interactions with the DNA-binding domain of FOXO3. These results may provide a foundation for further optimizing (4-propoxy)phenylpyrimidinylguanidine and developing therapeutics for inhibiting the activity of forkhead box (FOX) transcription factors and their interactions with other binding partners.
abstract_zh: FOXO3核定位增加与神经母细胞瘤化疗耐药及肿瘤血管生成有关。因此，抑制FOXO3是增强抗肿瘤免疫反应并抑制癌细胞中FOXO3介导的治疗耐药性的有前景策略。然而，目前尚无FOXO3抑制剂可供临床使用。尽管如此，我们近期已鉴定出(4-丙氧基)苯基嘧啶基胍作为癌细胞中低微摩尔范围的FOXO3抑制剂。在此，我们报告其一个小型衍生物库的合成及构效关系研究，其中一些衍生物在亚微摩尔范围内抑制癌细胞中FOXO3诱导的基因转录，因此其效力比母体化合物高一个数量级。通过核磁共振（NMR）和分子对接，我们表明这些化合物在与FOXO3的DNA结合域相互作用方面存在差异。这些结果可能为进一步优化(4-丙氧基)苯基嘧啶基胍以及开发抑制叉头框（FOX）转录因子活性及其与其他结合伙伴相互作用的治疗药物奠定基础。
